# Local API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_api_reference.py from the app's own routes. Do not edit by hand. -->

API version **1** (`GET /health` → `api_version`). The engine listens on `http://127.0.0.1:8765`. How to call it, with examples and the gotchas, is in [`docs/API.md`](../API.md); what the labels promise is in [API](api.md).

196 routes: **60 stable**, **25 experimental**, 111 internal.

| Label | Promise |
|---|---|
| stable | Documented as supported in `docs/API.md`. Changes only by adding; removing or reshaping it bumps the API version. Its request shape is pinned by `tests/test_api_contract.py`. |
| experimental | Meant for outside use, but its shape may still change in a release; every change is noted in `CHANGELOG.md`. |
| internal | Serves one screen of the desktop app and changes with it. Works, but depending on it is at your own risk. |

## Readiness

Details: [`docs/API.md` › Readiness](../API.md#readiness).

| Route | Label | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /health` | stable | Liveness, app version and API version. |
| `GET /health/preflight` | stable | Whether a job can actually run here: FFmpeg, Ollama, model, Whisper, GPU, disk. |
| `GET /system/stats` | stable | CPU, memory, disk and GPU use. |

## Submitting work

Details: [`docs/API.md` › Submitting work](../API.md#submitting-work).

| Route | Label | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /jobs` | stable | Queue one link with its options. |
| `POST /jobs/batch` | stable | Queue several links, each with its own options; bad ones are reported, not fatal. |
| `GET /sports` | stable | The sports a job's `sport` option can name, with their choices. |
| `POST /videos/local` | stable | Queue a video file already on this computer. |

## Watching progress

Details: [`docs/API.md` › Watching progress](../API.md#watching-progress).

| Route | Label | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /cancel` | stable | Ask a running video to stop at its next stage boundary. |
| `GET /jobs` | stable | Every job, newest last (a bare array). |
| `DELETE /jobs/{job_id}` | stable | Remove a job. |

| `GET /jobs/{job_id}/log` | stable | The job's own log file, last lines. |

## Plugins

Details: [`docs/API.md` › Plugins](../API.md#plugins).

| Route | Label | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /marketplace` | experimental | Listed plugins from the registry indexes, searched and filtered, with what is installed. |
| `GET /marketplace/catalog` | experimental | Awesome Clips Kitty's entries built with Clips Kitty (integrations, apps and tools), searched, with their sections, labels and numbers. |
| `GET /marketplace/counting` | experimental | Whether installs from the Marketplace are counted, and what counting sends. |
| `PUT /marketplace/counting` | experimental | Switch install counting on or off for this PC. Session header. |
| `GET /marketplace/online` | experimental | Whether the Marketplace checks Clips Kitty's online list by itself, when it last fetched it and how the last try went. |
| `PUT /marketplace/online` | experimental | Switch the Marketplace's automatic checks of Clips Kitty's online list on or off for this PC. Session header. |
| `POST /marketplace/refresh` | experimental | Fetch Clips Kitty's online list and the registry index addresses set in settings into the cache; automatic: the online list only, when a day old. Session header. |
| `GET /plugin-models` | experimental | Every model the installed plugins list, once: where it is, its licence and size, and which plugins use it. |
| `POST /plugin-models/download` | experimental | Download one plugin's model into the shared model folder, checked against its size and SHA-256. Session header. |
| `POST /plugin-models/plan` | experimental | What downloading one plugin's model would fetch, from Hugging Face's metadata; downloads nothing. Session header. |
| `GET /plugins` | experimental | Installed plugins with their versions, permissions and state, and the built-in modes. |
| `POST /plugins/install` | experimental | Install what a plan fetched. Session header. |
| `POST /plugins/plan` | experimental | Fetch a plugin from a folder or a Git commit and say what installing it would do, with the install screen as text. Session header. |
| `DELETE /plugins/{publisher}/{name}` | experimental | Remove a plugin, its files and its stored keys. Session header. |
| `POST /plugins/{publisher}/{name}/disable` | experimental | Turn a plugin off. Session header. |
| `POST /plugins/{publisher}/{name}/enable` | experimental | Turn a plugin on. Session header. |
| `POST /plugins/{publisher}/{name}/pin` | experimental | Stop update offers for a plugin. Session header. |
| `POST /plugins/{publisher}/{name}/rollback` | experimental | Go back to the version installed before. Session header. |
| `PUT /plugins/{publisher}/{name}/secrets` | experimental | Store a plugin's secret settings. Session header. |
| `POST /plugins/{publisher}/{name}/unpin` | experimental | Offer a plugin's updates again. Session header. |
